python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import music21, converter21, json
converter21.register()
root=Path('inputs/inputs') if Path('inputs/inputs/samples.json').exists() else Path('inputs')
print('INPUT_ROOT',root)
print('BRIEF', (root/'brief.txt').read_text())
print('SAMPLES',(root/'samples.json').read_text())
p=root/'baselines/audiveris-enlarged/sample-029.musicxml'
print('SOURCE_029',p.read_text()[:18000])
for name in json.loads((root/'samples.json').read_text()):
 p=root/'baselines/audiveris-enlarged'/f'{name}.krn'
 if not p.exists(): continue
 try:
  s=music21.converter.parse(p)
  out=Path('tmp')/f'{name}-canonical.krn';out.parent.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
  s.write('humdrum',fp=out)
  t=music21.converter.parse(out)
  print('ROUNDTRIP',name,len(s.recurse().notes),len(t.recurse().notes),s.duration.quarterLength,t.duration.quarterLength)
  print(out.read_text()[:12000])
 except Exception as e: print('FAILED',name,type(e).__name__,str(e))
PY
